scripts.build: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable $HOME/flutter && $HOME/flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --no-tree-shake-icons --dart-define="DB_URL=$DB_URL" --dart-define="DB_USER=$DB_USER" --dart-define="DB_PASS=$DB_PASS" --dart-define="DB_SCHEMA=$DB_SCHEMA" --dart-define="CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=$CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME" --dart-define="CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=$CLOUDINARY_API_KEY" --dart-define="CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=$CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET" --dart-define="INTERNAL_API_KEY=$INTERNAL_API_KEY" --dart-define="AI_API_KEY=$AI_API_KEY" --dart-define="AI_MODEL=$AI_MODEL" --dart-define="AI_API_URL=$AI_API_URL"
